sources.entry: Artbreeder - Collaborative AI tool for creating and editing images.

summary.name: Artbreeder
summary.one_liner: Artbreeder is a collaborative, AI-powered web tool for creating, mixing, and editing images such as characters and artworks.
use_cases: Mix and blend two or more images
Build collages from shapes, images and text
Edit images by adjusting genes or traits
Share and remix work with a creative community
summary.what_it_does: Artbreeder offers AI tools for creating characters, artworks, and other images. Splicer2 lets users mix, branch, and edit images in a single creative interface. Splicer mixes images and edits their underlying genes, such as age, gender, or color sliders. Collage builds an image from simple shapes, pictures, and text. The site also has a community section where users can explore images, follow creators, enter daily theme contests, and join remix parties.
notable: Gene-based editing: adjust traits like age, gender, and color on images
Splicer2 for mixing, branching, and editing images
Community features including daily theme contests and remix parties
caveats: Page lists a Pricing link but does not state prices or plan details
Page text does not say which features are free or paid
